areas.label: Goldwake's cabin
areas.desc: Sealed, airless for 140 years. Her body, the heart in her hand, her last cache. First air makes the arm fall.

areas.label: The cabin door (the seal)
areas.desc: Held by the ghosts. Opens only once they fall.

areas.label: The ghost-watch deck
areas.desc: The veterans' ghosts stand watch here. The fight before the cabin.
